Class SocketPlayerEntry

java.lang.Object
network.server.socket.SocketPlayerEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerEntry
public class SocketPlayerEntry extends Object implements PlayerEntry
Socket implementation of PlayerEntry. Bundles the player's name, inbound stream, SocketVirtualView and SocketClientHandler; wiring the game queue is delegated to the handler so the reader thread can route in-game commands once the player joins a session.

    • setGameQueue

      public void setGameQueue(BlockingQueue<GameCommand> queue)
      Description copied from interface: PlayerEntry
      Wires this player's incoming in-game commands to a running game session's queue. Called when the player joins or reconnects to an active game; the default no-op covers entries that never reach in-game state.
      Specified by:
      setGameQueue in interface PlayerEntry
      Parameters:
      queue - the game session's command queue to forward in-game commands to
